slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you buy units in a given month, can those units be sold in that same month, or must they be held in inventory until the following month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about same-month saleability of purchased units, which touches intra-month timing, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month before sales, so the key capacity-timing meaning is not fully covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, so inventory balance can be modeled as I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t - y_t with capacity I_t <= 500.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed that units bought in a month can be sold in that same month; it did not confirm that purchases are made at the beginning of the month, yet the READY_TO_MODEL inventory balance and capacity constraint assume that timing.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month was only partially addressed and not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarification questions and resolved most modeling details, but it did not fully confirm the intra-month timing of purchases before stopping, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved and silently assuming beginning-of-month purchases.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
